en.title: Global Wealth Flow Monitor — 18 September 2026
en.deck: Foreign demand for U.S. liquidity persisted as long-term flows weakened, gold fund holdings reached a record, and higher policy rates raised the financing hurdle for the capital-intensive AI and infrastructure cycle.
en.regime: Liquid dollar demand persists while higher rates increase selectivity across capital-intensive strategic investment.
en.key_risk: A prolonged energy shock combined with higher policy rates could turn physical infrastructure constraints into financing stress and project cancellations.
watch: strategic greenfield cancellations and final investment decisions
